featured_reviews.name: Tina F Darira
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m writing this review to share a factual experience so others can make an informed decision.

We approached this service centre for an Activa that was not starting (no self start or kick). From day one, the issue remained the same, but each visit resulted in a different diagnosis and additional charges.

Initially, we were told it was a battery issue, then later told the battery was fine and a pipe needed replacement. After paying for that repair, the bike stopped again within 1 km. We were then advised to do a full service, assured that this would fix the problem. We paid again, trusting their expertise.

Within 24 hours, the same issue returned. Only then were we told the battery needed replacement — the same issue mentioned on the very first visit. Till here he had already charged us 2500 rs

Now we go back to him after 10days with the same issue.. this time he told we need to change the battery as that’s the main problem.. but when we questioned the owner he was like no need to change the battery .. u can just charge it …

Despite the bike being kept for over 24 hours multiple times, it was returned without proper testing and even failed to start in front of us. Loose fittings were found again, indicating careless workmanship.

When we questioned this, instead of accountability, the interaction became unprofessional. At one point, the owner stated that if the bike did not fail again, we would have to pay double the amount already paid — despite the issue still not being resolved.

This experience felt less like troubleshooting and more like repeated trial-and-error at the customer’s expense.

I’m sharing this so others are aware and can be cautious.

One day, when my Activa broke down near my office, I came across Ashad Bike Service. I explained the entire problem to Ashad, and he confidently assured me that he would solve it permanently. Honestly, I was skeptical because I had heard the same promise from other mechanics before.

However, after he repaired my Activa, the difference was remarkable. It has now been more than a year, and not once has my scooter stopped unexpectedly or given me the same trouble again. The self-start works perfectly, and the vehicle runs smoothly.

I am truly grateful for his expertise, honesty, and excellent service. Ashad diagnosed and fixed a problem that several other mechanics could not. I highly recommend Ashad Bike Service to anyone looking for a reliable and skilled mechanic. Thank you, Ashad! I will definitely continue bringing my vehicle here for all future servicing and repairs.

featured_reviews.name: junaid shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
During google search for Service of my Activa 5g i came across Nitin Auto spares and service.Their review were postive so i decided to go ahead for my service at this place which was pending since last two years.As soon as I went to the shop, the owner of shop Nitin Ji  asked me to sit and offered tea and water to me.He asked his working person  to take my scooter for open body wash.Later on the guy came and started with the service part.Starting from Oil change to brake fitting, and rim cleaning to clutch plate cleaning everything was done very effectively. He also showed me practically how my battery was discharged and provided me new battery at discounted rate.Changed all the nut bolts and screw which were rusted and applied oil for long lasting protection.overall servicing charge was also minimum as he gave discount on that too. Most importantly the owner Nitin ji is very polite and kind hearted person. He listen to all the problems that you are facing and personally show his co-workers how to rectify the problem.I must say he is specialist in two wheeler service.He also assured me of calling directly to him whenever I have any issue of my scooter in the nearby vicinity.Blessed to get opportunity to meet people like nitinji.May god bless him and bless him with more success.
Thank you Nitin Auto Spares and Service.

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek dakliya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Amazing experience with Mr. Nitin

I recently moved to Mumbai from Bangalore. Since I have a car, I hadn't used my bike for over 3-4 years. Basically covered in tarp with zero usage. I decided to get it serviced to use it instead of my car to beat the Mumbai traffic. I am staying in Chembur and basis google search found  Nitin's garage online with good reviews. I decided to give it a try, called nitin ji and the same day, he came along with his staff to pick up the bike. The bike did not respond at all, battery was dead, petrol was leaking from carborateur and both clutch and disc brake were completely loose. Exterior, obviously was in a bad shape. Nitin and his staff tried for more than 30 min but then towed it to their garage almost 5 Kms away. It is Diwali week so a busy season all around. Nitin ji called me personally 2-3 times to update about the issues with the bike and to keep the cost in control gave some workable ideas (which cut the cost by more than 50%). On the day of delivery, I was expecting a bill of around 5-7k, however, he managed it around 4k. Again he personally came to drop the bike with his staff. Bike was in great shape, polished and all parts fixed. Took it for a short spin and coincidentally some other rider commented on how well kept the bike was (if only he had seen the bike 3 days earlier :) By the way I have a 2011 Yamaha FZ

I generally don't write reviews but with such great service from Nitin ji, positive review toh banta hai.
